gate_1_schema_integrity.description: Validates Pydantic schema typing and required attributes across all 13 sub-families.

gate_2_evidence_id_existence.description: Verifies that every referenced evidence ID exists in the read-only frozen legal corpora.

gate_3_dataset_1_linkage.description: Confirms canonical Section-level linkage to the Companies Act, 2013.

gate_4_dataset_2_linkage.description: Confirms authentic judgment and citation linkage to the Curated Judicial Corpus.

gate_5_synthetic_perturbations.description: Verifies that adversarial injections and synthetic perturbations have correct failure types and expected statuses.

gate_6_deduplication_and_uniqueness.description: Confirms global ID uniqueness across all 1,000+ benchmark items.

gate_7_split_isolation_and_zero_leakage.description: Proves 100% legal-unit isolation between Train (70%), Dev (15%), and Test (15%) with zero overlap.

gate_8_ground_truth_and_non_triviality.description: Confirms all ground truth answers possess atomic facts, negative bounds, and substantive length.

gate_9_robustness_soundness.description: Verifies fail-closed constraints, temporal metadata, and conflict authority justifications.

gate_10_human_annotation_audit.description: Validates diversity across easy, medium, hard, and adversarial tiers.
